capabilities: Expand local graph nodes beyond the native depth limit via a context menu
Reduce or reset expanded branches, including a reset for all expansions
Render extra nodes and edges as a PIXI overlay without mutating the native graph
Support nested expansion where an overlay node roots a new branch
Highlight expanded roots with colored rings and branch colors
extras: Manifest describes it as an experimental patch not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README warns the plugin may need updates if Obsidian changes internal Local Graph rendering APIs.
intentEvidence: extends the Local Graph with manual branch expansion beyond the native depth limit
problem: Obsidian's local graph has a fixed depth limit, so you cannot expand a specific branch on demand to see more distant linked notes.
summary: Local graph extension that expands individual nodes beyond the native depth limit, rendering extra branches as overlay nodes.
